create_ConfigenConf: create a ConfigenConf dataclass instance to configure output directory, module path pattern, modules list, and header for config generation
create_ModuleConf: create a ModuleConf dataclass instance to configure a module name, list of classes, and default flags for configen
create_Flags: create a Flags dataclass instance to set optional convert mode and recursive flag defaults for configen modules
create_Config: create a Config dataclass instance with optional init config directory and nested configen configuration for the configen tool
review_ConfigStore_schema: review the ConfigStore singleton that registers the configen_schema node with the Config dataclass for Hydra configuration
